summary: Privately owned tower in Greenup County, KY, registered with NHLR in January 2026; build date and design not found; two sources disagree on ownership.

facts.status_note: NHLR has no status field. The owner reports work on the tower as of 2025, so it appears to still stand.

access.note: Privately owned per NHLR. The sources read do not say whether visitors are welcome.

events.note: The owner's mother worked here as a lookout from 1966 to 1969, per NHLR.
Owner reports recent work on the tower, including replacing its flooring, as of 2025.
Registered January 2, 2026 as US 1799, KY 16; nominated by David Baldridge.

evidence.quote: This tower is owned by David Baldridge.

evidence.supports: owner's mother worked as a lookout 1966 to 1969
evidence.quote: His mother previously worked here as a lookout from 1966 to 1969.

evidence.supports: owner reports recent work including replacing flooring as of 2025
evidence.quote: David reports that, as of 2025, he recently made reports to the tower including replacing its flooring.

evidence.supports: listing given as Greenup County and the Kentucky Division of Forestry
evidence.quote: Greenup County - Kentucky Division of Forestry

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR lists a private owner, David Baldridge. The Forest Lookouts page gives its listing as Greenup County - Kentucky Division of Forestry. Neither source dates the change, so the record reports both and picks neither.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources. The Forest Lookouts entry is a bare listing with no dates or details. Build year, design and height are not found after two web searches. Ownership conflict is unresolved; the Kentucky Division of Forestry or the owner would settle it. Abandoned Online lists the tower with no details and was not used. The Wikipedia entry for the community has no tower information.
